title: Mitigating the Likelihood Paradox in Flow-based OOD Detection: An Entropic Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2602.09581v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Deep generative models that can tractably compute input likelihoods, including normalizing flows, often assign unexpectedly high likelihoods to out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs. We mitigate this paradox from an entropic perspective with Semantic Proportional Entropy Manipulation (SPEM), a training-free procedure that applies stronger perturbations to inputs less similar to an in-distribution (ID) memory bank. We derive theoretical lower bounds showing that this entropy gap increases the expected log-likelihood difference in favor of the ID, and experiments on standard benchmarks show that this manipulation realigns the likelihood ordering with human intuition. Strikingly, this realignment persists even when the flow is given only visually meaningless noise instead of the original input, and we analyze this phenomenon theoretically to characterize the conditions under which it occurs.

translated_title: 缓解基于流的OOD检测中的似然悖论：一种熵视角
translated_abstract: 能够便捷计算输入似然的深度生成模型（包括归一化流）常常对分布外（OOD）输入赋予意外高的似然值。我们从熵的视角出发，提出语义比例熵操控（SPEM）来缓解这一悖论，这是一种无需训练的方法，对与分布内（ID）记忆库相似度较低的输入施加更强的扰动。我们推导出理论下界，证明这种熵差能够以有利于分布内数据的方式增大期望对数似然差，并且在标准基准上的实验表明，这种操控使似然排序与人类直觉重新对齐。令人惊讶的是，即使只给流模型提供视觉上无意义的噪声而非原始输入，这种重新对齐依然存在，我们从理论上分析了这一现象，刻画了其发生的条件。
tldr: 提出免训练的语义比例熵操控方法SPEM，从熵的视角通过对与分布内记忆库相似度低的输入施加更强扰动，增大对数似然差的期望下界，从而缓解基于流的OOD检测中的似然悖论，使似然排序与人类直觉对齐。
en_tdlr: SPEM, a training-free Semantic Proportional Entropy Manipulation, mitigates the likelihood paradox in flow-based OOD detection from an entropic perspective by applying stronger perturbations to inputs less similar to an in-distribution memory bank, with theoretical lower bounds showing it increases the expected log-likelihood gap in favor of ID data and realigns likelihood ordering with human intuition.
